sponsoredBills.summary: Amends the Housing and Community Development Act of 1974 to allow grantees to use Community Development Block Grant amounts for natural disaster mitigation activities in high-risk areas, and requires the Secretary of Housing and Urban Development to issue implementing rules within one year.
sponsoredBills.title: Ounce of Prevention Act

latestAction.text: Referred to the House Committee on Ways and Means.

sponsoredBills.summary: Amends the Internal Revenue Code to provide businesses with a tax credit of up to $2,500 per student for contributions to educational and workforce training consortia programs, with a national annual limitation of $500 million for calendar years 2027–2031.
sponsoredBills.title: SKILL Act

latestAction.text: Referred to the House Committee on Transportation and Infrastructure.

sponsoredBills.summary: Requires the Secretary of the department in which the Coast Guard operates to establish a four-year pilot program creating a Cetacean Desk within the San Francisco Vessel Traffic Service to coordinate with the maritime industry and monitor large cetaceans to reduce vessel strikes and impacts in the San Francisco Bay region.
sponsoredBills.title: Save Willy Act of 2026

latestAction.text: Referred to the House Committee on Financial Services.

sponsoredBills.summary: Establishes federal requirements for when financial institutions may release securities, digital assets, or investment accounts to states under escheatment laws, generally prohibiting such transfers unless the account owner has been deceased for at least three years or there has been no contact for five years.
sponsoredBills.title: SAFER Act of 2026

latestAction.text: Referred to the House Committee on the Judiciary.

sponsoredBills.summary: Amends the Immigration and Nationality Act to codify the Optional Practical Training program, allowing international students to engage in practical training and employment related to their field of study, including after completing degree requirements, while maintaining student status if they have pending or approved immigrant petitions.
sponsoredBills.title: Keep Innovators in America Act

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Armed Services, and in addition to the Committee on Rules, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.

sponsoredBills.summary: Amends title 10 to require presidential notification and congressional approval before the Department of Defense provides support to civilian law enforcement. Limits initial support to 30 days without joint resolution approval. Prohibits simultaneous service in the Defense Department and civilian law enforcement.
sponsoredBills.title: Military in Law Enforcement Accountability Act

latestAction.text: Referred to the Committee on Ways and Means, and in addition to the Committee on Energy and Commerce, for a period to be subsequently determined by the Speaker, in each case for consideration of such provisions as fall within the jurisdiction of the committee concerned.

sponsoredBills.title: To amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to extend and modify the enhanced premium tax credit, and for other purposes.

sponsoredBills.title: RESIDE Act

sponsoredBills.title: SUN Act

sponsoredBills.title: BUILD Housing Act

sponsoredBills.summary: Amends the National Housing Act to establish a Department of Housing and Urban Development program insuring second liens for financing accessory dwelling unit construction. Permits Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac to purchase and securitize these insured loans, subject to director discretion regarding market risk.
sponsoredBills.title: Supporting Upgraded Property Projects and Lending for Yards (SUPPLY) Act

sponsoredBills.summary: Amends the National Housing Act to establish an FHA program insuring second liens for accessory dwelling unit construction, with maximum loan amounts based on property value and projected rental income. Permits Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac to purchase and securitize these insured loans.
sponsoredBills.title: To amend the National Housing Act to direct the Secretary of Housing and Urban Development to establish a program to insure certain second liens secured against property for the purpose of financing the construction of an accessory dwelling unit, and for other purposes.
